text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up and buy something already.
How long are you gonna take picking?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aaah? Let a girl take her damn time deciding.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're just gonna get black coffee anyway, right?
Acting all tough drinking it lately.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? Stop running your mouth!
That settles it, no way in hell I'm buying that now!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why are you being so stubborn?
Are you stupid or what?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You two are getting along great as usual today!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: How are we?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka! For today's outdoor training,
let's race to see who reaches the meetup spot first!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You're on!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: See, totally best buds after all.

While waiting at the meetup spot
for joint training—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... NUMBER ONE!!
Where's Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Dammit, took the wrong turn...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ Too slow!
I win!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aargh, shut up, shut up!

As the two squabbled back and forth,
a child came running over.

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!! It's Daiwa Scarlet!
I'm always cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Eh...? A-A fan of mine...?

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
But you're different from how you look on TV!
Yelling 'Number one!' like a little kid! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah... um, that was just, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Listen up, kid.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Taking everything seriously and being obsessed
with taking 1st place ain't a bad thing.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you laugh at that and call it childish,
you're gonna end up as one of those lame adults
who gives up on competing from the start, got it?

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
...Gasp!? I don't wanna be lame!
I won't laugh at trying to be number one anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Look who's talking big,
even though you lost.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Shut it!
I ain't losing next time!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Once again...
thank you for cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just like she said... I've always aimed
to be number one ever since I was little.
Maybe that's why I act childish sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But you know, no matter what happens,
I never want to give up 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So please keep rooting for me, okay!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

After watching their entire exchange unfold,
I thought about what to say to her.
choice_data_list: I think that's a great mindset.
I don't think you're childish at all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it's only natural for an athlete
to feel that way, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I know that feeling burns way stronger
in me than in anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just training,
I'm not giving up 1st place to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
You're saying the exact same thing she did...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no, it's nothing.
Let's give it our all today too!
